searchText: > https://github.com/ipsilon/execution-spec-tests/releases/tag/eip7692%40v1.0.4%2Bipsilon_bf37249b > > just wanted to check which other breaking changes on top of v1.0.4 does it contain? CC <@508125616940515329> just to reiterate from the other channel: it's unlikely you need the ipsilon fork release, go for the https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/ ones first. As per Marios question: it contains the [MAX_INITCODE_SIZE change tests] (https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/125) Could someone trace this test for me in a non-geth client? `fixtures/blockchain_tests/prague/eip7692_eof_v1/eip3540_eof_v1/calls/eof_calls_eof_mstore.json` Banging my head against some gas mismatches <@892053833121923094> can we expect EOF tests on top of Prague? I am not able to run `blockchain_tests` for now, since our eof branch is always merged with main, which contains updates for Prague proposals. So it's a bit problematic to undo some updates without braking stuff. EXT\*CALL has different return values for success and failure. PC=28 gets a 1 from the EXTCALL, should be a 0 as it was EXT\*CALL success. So SSTORE price goes up as it's 0->1 storage rather than 0->0. If you fill from Besu the blockchain tests have Prague and Cancun system transactions executed. Best to fill from a `main` branch dev build to get all the bug fixes. `fill --fork=CancunEIP7692 tests/prague/eip7692_eof_v1 --evm-bin <besu-repo>/build/install/besu/bin/evmtool` What config do we need in besu to run Prague+EOF? I could try to add it today to the eest ci to build with this instead For compatibility with the fill tests, the "Prague" fork in t8n and reference tests maps internally to the "PragueEOF" fork. You can also use the "CancunEOF" fork in t8n to get the cancun+EOF. Besu refernece tests don't have a Prague / no EOF mode. What other info do you need for config? We would be building the t8n server in the ci, so the minimal build steps would be very nice docker works? I can try to make it work 🙂 Ok, so prefereably not docker. Got a file to point me to as a template?

excerpts.author: _shemnon
excerpts.content: EXT\*CALL has different return values for success and failure.  PC=28 gets a 1 from the EXTCALL, should be a 0 as it was EXT\*CALL success.  So SSTORE price goes up as it's 0->1 storage rather than 0->0.

excerpts.content: For compatibility with the fill tests, the "Prague" fork in t8n and reference tests maps internally to the "PragueEOF" fork.  You can also use the "CancunEOF" fork in t8n to get the cancun+EOF.  Besu refernece tests don't have a Prague / no EOF mode.  What other info do you need for config?
